comparison.objective: Fit a spring-loaded delta-printer arm pair over two effector ball studs. Candidate tunes and locks an adjustable shock absorber, then validates stopping behavior through repeated cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires spreading two coupled arms about 14 mm against approximately 4 N while positioning a loose effector so two sockets seat simultaneously. Candidate requires recessed-key insertion, bimanual counterholding, collar adjustment, bounded tightening, and iterative response correction.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires both sockets aligned within 1.5 mm, arm width within 1.5 mm of 84 mm, effector flat, hands clear, and 1 s stability. Candidate instead requires two non-bottoming, non-rebounding physical impacts within published energy, speed, and 12 mm stroke constraints after lock retention.
comparison.reason: The record tests spring-opposed dual socket seating; the candidate tests adjustable damping, locking, and dynamic commissioning. Shared bimanual stabilization is generic. Candidate rebound, overload, drift, and witness-torque thresholds remain undeclared but do not erase the different tested ability.
